title: Shear Shrooms
description: Right click mushroom blocks with shears to snip faces down to the hidden pore texture, press a mushroom on to grow the cap back. No new blocks, pure vanilla blockstates. Fabric mod + Paper plugin.
body:
Give your giant mushrooms a haircut.

Every mushroom block in the game already knows how to look bare. The pore
texture has been hiding in its blockstate since forever, you just never had a
way to get at it. Shear Shrooms hands you the scissors: right click any face
of a red mushroom block, brown mushroom block, or mushroom stem with shears
and that face snips down to the pore texture, popping off a mushroom as it
goes. Change your mind? Press a matching mushroom against the bare face and
the cap grows right back.

That is the whole mod, and that is the point. No new blocks, no items, no
resource pack, no config. It flips the blockstates vanilla already ships,
which buys you two lovely things:

* Put it on your server and every player gets it instantly, even on a
  completely untouched vanilla client.
* Builds made with it are plain vanilla blocks. Uninstall and your mushroom
  mansion stays exactly as you sculpted it.

Builders get a clean new palette out of blocks they already farm: poreless
stems as pillars, mixed cap-and-pore walls, mushroom furniture with the right
texture on every visible face.

The fine print you will actually like:

* Perfectly fair economy. A snip gives one mushroom, regrowing costs one.
  Nothing to dupe, nothing to lose.
* Stems regrow with either mushroom color (they drop nothing when sheared,
  there is no stem item to give you).
* Shears spend 1 durability per snip, Unbreaking works, creative is free.
* Sneak and right click to bypass the mod whenever you want pure vanilla
  behavior, like planting a mushroom on top.

Three downloads, pick your platform: Fabric for 1.21.x, Fabric for 26.1.x,
and one Paper/Spigot plugin jar that runs on both 1.21.x and 26.1.x servers.

Original concept by derexxd (u/DereChen) on Reddit (r/minecraftsuggestions) -
